title: Reading IF Logic
learning_objectives: Read a simple COBOL IF statement
Explain how numeric comparison affects control flow
snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BALANCECHK.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 ACCOUNT-BALANCE PIC 9(4) VALUE 1200.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           IF ACCOUNT-BALANCE > 1000
               DISPLAY 'PRIORITY ACCOUNT'
           ELSE
               DISPLAY 'STANDARD ACCOUNT'
           END-IF
           STOP RUN.

practice_question.prompt: In this snippet, what is being checked by the IF statement?

choices.D: Whether the program name is BALANCECHK

timed_task.prompt: Given the starting value in the snippet, which message is displayed?

pre_test.prompt: What does an IF statement generally do in a programming language?

choices.B: Chooses between paths based on a condition

pre_test.prompt: In a comparison like X > 10, what does > mean?

post_test.prompt: Why does the ELSE branch not run in this snippet?
What role does END-IF play in COBOL?

choices.B: It marks the end of the IF block
